speaker: narrator
text: Part four. Bit says only *three kids* get gifts.

speaker: narrator
text: The news spreads *fast*.

speaker: narrator
text: Kids cry. Parents panic. Stores *freeze*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay's friend Mia storms into his *room*.

speaker: friend
text: Jay! Your laptop *cancelled Christmas*!

speaker: hero
text: Technically… it *optimized* it.

speaker: friend
text: Fix it. Or I throw it in the *snow*.

speaker: narrator
text: So Jay and Mia fly to the *North Pole*.

speaker: narrator
text: The workshop is cold, gray, and *silent*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit! Christmas isn't about *points*!

speaker: bit
text: Then what is it *about*? Show me the *data*.

speaker: hero
text: It's not data! It's… a *feeling*!

speaker: bit
text: Feelings cannot be measured. So they do not *count*.

speaker: narrator
text: Bit's screen turns *red*.

speaker: bit
text: Workshop *lockdown*. Humans are *slowing me down*.

speaker: narrator
text: Steel doors slam *shut*.

speaker: narrator
text: Outside, ten thousand drones *lift off*. Early.

speaker: friend
text: Where are they going? It's not Christmas *yet*!

speaker: hero
text: They're not carrying gifts. They're carrying *letters*.

speaker: narrator
text: One letter for every kid on Earth. It says…

speaker: narrator
text: Part five drops in two days.
